column1: # CPU Throttle — CPU database (edit with any spreadsheet app; save as CSV
# Lines that start with # are ignored. One row per processor.
# match            Model tokens as they appear in the CPU name
#                  Every word must match exactly (so 5800H never matches 5800HS). More words = more specific.
# base_ghz/boost_ghz  Base and maximum turbo clock.
# pl1_default_w    Recommended PL1 for this CPU (what "Use recommended" and Balanced apply).
# pl1_max_w        Highest PL1 the app will let you set (cTDP-up). The PL1 box never goes above this.
# pl2_default_w    Recommended short-term limit (PL2).   pl2_max_w  Highest PL2 the app will allow.
# tjmax_c          Maximum junction temperature; the tray "hot" colour starts 10 C below it.
# passmark_* / cinebench_r23_* / geekbench6_*   Reference benchmark scores (multi / single). Leave empty if unknown.
# Your own file ~/.config/cputhrottle/cpudb.csv overrides this one (the app's "Add this CPU" button writes there).
